## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm build && pnpm check && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build:example` pass
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md is updated for a change that users can see
- [ ] No official material was copied or traced: no official artwork, logos, emblems, fonts, screenshots, quotes or character likenesses, and no character names; words of the `'trigger'` palette stay general concepts and live only in `src/flavor.ts`. New graphics are original work and are listed in ASSETS.md (author, licence); new fonts are OFL or system fonts
- [ ] New or changed colours keep text at 4.5:1 and focus rings and other UI at 3:1 (the contrast tests cover the palette tokens)
- [ ] The `'trigger'` palette stays reading first: no transitions, animations, shadows, gradients or rounded corners, one accent (`pnpm test` checks the stylesheet)
